svg.text: Complete Integration Architecture - How SIEM Connects Everything
Endpoints (10,000+) | Servers | Network Infrastructure | Cloud Resources | Applications | IoT/OT Devices
This is what we're protecting - the crown jewels
↓ All telemetry flows to SIEM for correlation ↓
Splunk | IBM QRadar | Microsoft Sentinel | Elastic Security
Splunk SOAR | Palo Alto XSOAR | IBM Resilient
Isolate endpoint, block IP, disable user,
Deep dive analysis, use SIEM tools
SOC uses SIEM to detect, SOAR to respond
• All security tools send logs/telemetry TO SIEM
• EDR, Firewall, Cloud, Identity, Apps → SIEM
• Sends alerts to SOAR for automated response
• SOAR executes playbooks based on SIEM alerts
Disable user (AD), Delete email, Create ticket
SIEM's Role: The Central Nervous System
SIEM is NOT an ecosystem by itself - it's the INTEGRATION HUB that connects the entire security ecosystem
CrowdStrike Falcon (EDR/XDR) provides deep endpoint visibility → SIEM correlates with network, cloud, identity, apps → Complete threat picture
SIEM is unavoidable in TDR/XDR/EDR discussions because it's where all security data converges for holistic threat detection
Modern Security = Prevention (Firewalls, AV, MFA) + Detection (EDR, XDR, NDR, SIEM) + Response (SOAR, IR) + People (SOC Team)
